title: Poultry House — Yasnaya Polyana
source: Ordinary museum photo of the two service buildings plus retained PMTiles/Mapzen; specific role/front assignment is inferred.
axis: Native east/up/south axes baked; X southeast along mapped long axis, with door/window gable inferred at+X.
identityStatus: Two adjacent retained one-story shed footprints are candidates for the small gray-gabled poultry house and longer red-hipped equipment shed shown together in the ordinary museum photograph. Sizes and separation support this assignment. The retained long axes are nearly parallel; the photograph may show different faces through perspective/parallax, and no camera position is known. Specific poultry/equipment function and absolute front assignment remain explicit photo/relative-context inferences; the public map names both only as sheds. Use the photographed gray roof on the small building despite the generic map red-roof tag. This small mapped footprint supplies8.46x5.72m scale; localX southeast is the inferred door/window gable. Its mapped neighbor remains independent. Source axes are baked east/up/south, heading0.

reconstruction.scope: Complete independent small log poultry-house interpretation: slightly irregular mapped walls, white plinth, brown recessed gable door and white-framed divided window, closed timber gables, steep weathered-gray roof with closed eave/fascia thickness, corner log ends and a supported approach stair. Use shared wood_log, wood_plain, wood_vertical, shingle_cedar, plaster_lime and storefront surfaces. The companion red-roof shed remains a separate model; no trees, copied signs, people or photo pixels are baked in.
